definitions.full: H148. adargazar [ אֲדַרְגָּזַר ] noun masculine counsellor (Persian loan-word = andarzaghar Nö COT Dan 3:2 Tabari 462 Andr M 51 * Str 42* Dr Scheft ii. 57 ; Mey Entst. J. 25 questions, and thinks military title); — plural emphatic אֲדַרְגָָּֽןְרַיָּא 3:2-3 ,.
